introduction: Pennsylvania CHIP offers health insurance to uninsured children and teenagers who do not qualify for Medicaid.
description: Pennsylvania CHIP offers health insurance to uninsured children and teenagers who do not qualify for Medicaid.

sections.who: Children must be younger than 19, live in Pennsylvania and meet citizenship or qualified-status requirements. Household income determines whether coverage is free or has premiums and copays.
sections.get: Coverage includes medical visits, prescriptions, dental and vision care. Compare participating insurers and their provider networks.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use COMPASS or the application options on the state CHIP page.

  2. Answer follow-up requests

    Supply household details so the appropriate coverage program can be determined.

  3. Confirm enrollment

    Check the insurer, effective date and any payment requirement.
sections.after: Return annual renewal information so coverage can continue. CHIP customer service is 800-986-5437.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using State CHIP application. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is CHIP only for very low incomes?
No. Higher-income families may qualify for paid coverage.
Income and household size affect costs.
Can I keep the same doctor?
Yes. Follow the insurer’s annual renewal instructions.
